app.name: Kinema
auth.setup.title: Welcome to Kinema
auth.setup.description: Create the administrator account. It manages libraries and settings.
auth.name: Name
search.title: Results for “{q}”
search.none.title: Nothing found
search.none.message: Try a shorter or different title.
home.empty.title: Your library is empty
home.empty.admin: Add a folder with movies or TV shows and Kinema will organise it, fetch posters and get it ready to play.
home.empty.user: The administrator has not added any libraries yet.
home.empty.scanning: Kinema is scanning your folders. New titles appear here as they are found.
library.sort.title: Title
library.empty.title: No titles yet
library.empty.scanning: Scanning the folders. Titles appear here as they are found.
library.empty.message: No video files were found in this library's folders.
library.name: Name
library.hint.movie: One movie per file. Names like “Inception (2010).mkv” or folders like “Inception (2010)/” match best.
library.hint.show: One folder per show, e.g. “Breaking Bad/Season 1/Breaking.Bad.S01E01.mkv”.
library.hint.other: Any videos. Each file is listed by its name.
library.deleteConfirm: Remove the library “{name}”? Your files stay on disk; only Kinema's list and watch history for it are removed.
series.title: Audio & subtitles
series.hint: Tracks come from the first episode. Every episode uses the same track position, so this works when all episodes come from the same release.
series.noStreams: The first episode has not been probed yet. Try again after the scan finishes.
match.none: No results. Try a shorter title or remove the year.
player.markers.title: Skip markers
player.markers.note: Set from the playhead or type a time. A marker you save is kept; clearing one lets the server look for it again.
player.markers.invalid: The end must come after the start, inside the video.
watch.nothing: Nothing else to watch here yet
player.boost: Volume boost: louder than the file's own level
player.error: This video could not be played in this browser.
player.noFile: This title has no playable file.
player.mode.direct.hint: The original file plays as is.
player.mode.remux.hint: Repackaged for the browser without re-encoding the video.
player.mode.transcode.hint: Converted on the server because this browser cannot decode the original.
player.mpv.openHint: mpv decodes this file on your computer, so the server does not have to convert it.
player.mpv.hint: The video plays in its own window. Closing it brings you back here.
settings.title: Settings
settings.noLibraries.title: No libraries
settings.noLibraries.message: Add a folder with your movies or shows to get started.
settings.tmdb.description: Posters, summaries, ratings and episode titles come from The Movie Database (TMDB). Create a free account at themoviedb.org, then paste its API key or read access token here.
settings.tmdb.label: TMDB API key or read access token
settings.tmdb.replace: Paste a new key to replace the current one
settings.ffmpegMissing: ffmpeg and ffprobe were not found. Files are listed, but only browser-ready files play and track switching is off. Install ffmpeg or set KINEMA_FFMPEG.
settings.dashboard.name: Name
settings.general.name: Server name
settings.general.nameHint: Shown on the sign-in screen and in the browser tab.
settings.general.publicUrlHint: Where the apps reach this server away from home, such as a reverse proxy or tunnel. At home they use the local address. Leave empty if the server is only on your network.
settings.library.watchHint: Uses filesystem events, so an idle server costs no CPU. Turn off for drives that misreport changes, and use Scheduled Tasks instead.
settings.library.thumbnailsHint: Titles without TMDB artwork show a frame from the video. Made in the background, one at a time, after each scan.
settings.library.positionHint: How far into the video the frame is taken. Changing it makes new thumbnails for files that do not have one yet; use Regenerate thumbnails in Libraries to redo the rest.
settings.tmdb.title: The Movie Database
settings.metadata.title: Metadata language
settings.metadata.languageHint: Titles, summaries and episode names in this language when TMDB has them. Applies to new lookups; use Match missing metadata or Fix match to refresh existing titles.
settings.languages.audioHint: The player starts with this audio track when a file has it.
settings.languages.mode.off.hint: Subtitles start off. Viewers can turn them on in the player.
settings.languages.mode.always.hint: Subtitles in the preferred subtitle language start on.
settings.languages.mode.foreign.hint: Subtitles start on only when the audio is not in the preferred audio language.
settings.languages.subtitle: Preferred subtitle language
settings.languages.subtitleHint: With File default, the first text subtitle is used.
settings.languages.ocrFound: Turns PGS and VobSub subtitles into text after each scan, so players can show them without converting the video. Slow on a large library; runs in the background. Languages: {languages}.
settings.languages.ocrNone: Install tesseract on the server to read PGS and VobSub subtitles. Kinema checks again when it starts.
settings.transcoder.intro: Most files play directly or are repackaged without re-encoding, which costs almost no CPU. These options apply only when a browser cannot decode the video and the server has to convert it.
settings.transcoder.maxHint: Further viewers who need a conversion are asked to try later. Direct play is never limited.
settings.transcoder.presetHint: Faster presets use less CPU and give larger or slightly worse video.
settings.transcoder.qualityHint: Higher quality sends more data over the network.
settings.transcoder.heightHint: Converted video is scaled down to this height. Never scaled up.
settings.transcoder.hardwareFound: Encodes on the graphics card ({name}), which takes most of the work off the processor.
settings.transcoder.hardwareNone: No usable graphics encoder was found, so the processor encodes. Kinema checks again when it starts.
settings.transcoder.threadsHint: Auto shares the processor cores between the simultaneous conversions (at least 4 each), so converting never takes the whole machine. Raise it if converted video stutters.
settings.network.urlHint: Use this address on phones, TVs and other computers on the same network.
settings.network.fingerprintHint: The server makes its own HTTPS certificate. When an app connects the first time it shows this code: check that they match before you trust it.
settings.network.localOnly: The server only accepts connections from this computer. Set host = "0.0.0.0" in kinema.toml to reach it from other devices.
settings.scheduled.rescanHint: For network drives that do not report file changes. Unchanged files are skipped, so a rescan is cheap.
settings.troubleshooting.thumbnailsHint: Made again in the background right away.
settings.troubleshooting.subtitlesHint: Converted again the next time a subtitle is turned on.
settings.troubleshooting.imagesHint: Downloaded again the next time a poster is shown.
connect.subtitle: Your movies and shows, from your own server.
auth.profiles.title: Who's watching?
users.title: Profiles
users.deleteConfirm: Delete the profile “{name}”? Its watch history goes with it. Media files are not touched.
users.name: Name
users.adminHint: Can change settings, libraries and profiles. Needs a password.
users.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.pinHint: Optional, 4 to 8 digits. Without a PIN the profile opens with one tap.
users.pinKeep: Leave empty to keep the current PIN.
users.accessAllHint: Sees everything, including libraries added later.
about.title: About Kinema
about.description: Your own media server: movies and shows from your folders, streamed to every screen in the house.
about.privacyValue: Runs on your own server. Your library and watch history never leave it.
about.developerNote: Designed and built by a single developer.
about.acknowledgementsHint: Libraries and projects Kinema is built on
about.acknowledgementsDescription: Kinema is built on these open-source projects and services.
credits.tmdb: Movie and show metadata and artwork. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
credits.plex: The idea of a personal media server. No Plex code or assets are used.
update.title: Server updates
update.youHave: This server runs {version}. Run the command for how it was installed:
update.cmd.docker: Docker Compose, from the folder with docker-compose.yml
update.commandHint: Your settings, libraries and watch history are kept.
desktopUpdate.title: Desktop app
desktopUpdate.restartsWhenDone: The app downloads it and restarts.
desktopUpdate.installerOpens: The installer is saved to Downloads and opens.
desktopUpdate.upToDate: Kinema for desktop {version} is up to date.
playlist.title: Playlists
playlist.empty.title: No playlists yet
playlist.empty.message: Make a playlist from any movie or episode with Add to playlist.
playlist.name: Playlist name
playlist.none: You have no playlists yet. Name one below to start.
playlist.deleteConfirm: Delete the playlist “{name}”? The titles stay in your library.
playlist.share: Share with everyone on this server
playlist.shareHint: Others can watch it but not change it. They only see titles they have access to.
collection.name: Collection name
collection.none: No collections yet. Name one below to start.
collection.deleteConfirm: Delete the collection “{name}”? The titles stay in your library.
edit.title: Edit details
edit.field.title: Title
edit.lockHint: A locked field is kept when Kinema rescans, refreshes from TMDB or you fix the match. Saving a text field locks it. Lock a poster, backdrop or genres to keep them as they are.
shelves.intro: Rows on Home that list the titles of one genre, newest first. Every profile can hide a shelf for itself.
library.folders.title: Folders of {name}
library.folders.pollHint: For network shares (NFS, SMB) that send no change events: Kinema lists the folders on a timer and scans only when something differs.
auth.profiles.homeOnlyHint: {name} has no PIN, so it only opens at home.
profile.title: My profile
profile.description: How the player starts for {name}, on every device.
profile.audioHint: The player starts with this audio track when a file has it.
profile.subtitle: Subtitle language
profile.limitNote: Content limit: {limit}. Only an administrator can change it.
household.title: Household rules
household.limitHint: Titles rated above this are hidden everywhere, including search and direct links.
household.unratedHint: Home videos and titles without a certification. Off hides them under a limit.
household.lanUnlockHint: On the home network the profile opens with one tap. Away from home the PIN is still asked.
household.lanUnlockNeedsPin: Set a PIN first: without one the profile already opens with one tap, at home only.
household.languagesHint: Track languages for this profile; Server default follows Settings › Languages.
transfer.title: Export or import
transfer.exportHint: Watch history and preferences as a JSON file, for another Kinema server.
transfer.includeLockHint: Anyone with the file can try to guess them offline. Keep it private.
transfer.importHint: Progress is matched by title; newer progress on this server is kept.
transfer.importSelfHint: Brings in watch history and languages. Content limits stay as the administrator set them.
transfer.applyLock: Also restore the PIN and password from the file
transfer.result: {imported} imported, {kept} kept (newer here), {unmatched} not on this server.
transfer.lockApplied: The PIN and password were restored; the profile was signed out everywhere.
transfer.badFile: This file could not be read.
rating.label: Rating
rating.hint: A certification such as PG-13, TV-14 or 16. Empty uses the one from TMDB.
share.title: Share link
share.description: Anyone with the link can watch {title} and what is under it, nothing else, until it expires or you revoke it.
share.label: Who is it for?
share.created: Copy the link now: it is not shown again.
shares.title: Share links
shares.empty: No share links yet. Open a title and choose Share.
shares.revokeConfirm: Revoke the link to {title}? Anyone watching through it is stopped.
sharePage.unavailable: This link has expired, was revoked, or never existed.
